text_block_list.name: Overseas Tourist
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me!
Me want go this hotel..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, take that intersection... No.
I'll guide you myself! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm glad I managed to see you off safely.
Though I had no idea it was quite so far away...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's going to take just as long to get back, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having guided the way all the distance out here, Seeking the Pearl ended up completely exhausted.
